build_ResNet50_body: build a ResNet50 conv4 body by calling add_ResNet50_conv4_body with a Caffe2 model
build_ResNet101_body: build a ResNet101 conv5 body by calling add_ResNet101_conv5_body with a Caffe2 model
add_ResNet_stage: add a ResNet stage with n residual blocks using add_stage with prefix and dimensions
add_ResNet_roi_head: add an RoI feature transformation and res5 head using add_ResNet_roi_conv5_head
add_bottleneck_transformation: add a bottleneck transformation with 1x1-3x3-1x1 convs using bottleneck_transformation
